There are two main workflows to classify landscape patterns using the `spatPatClassifyR` package: Either using landscape metrics as features for classification, or using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to classify patterns directly from the pixel information of landscape images.

Please refer to the respective vignettes for detailed guides on each workflow:

- [Classify landscapes using landscape metrics](classify-metrics.qmd)
- [Classify landscapes using Keras on landscape rasters](classify-pixels.qmd)

There are also more detailed vignettes on specific topics:

- [Importing user-defined landscapes](importing-landscapes.qmd)
- [Landscape generation](landscape-generation.qmd)
